task: Rewire narwhal's portal seam checks (R55, R117/R117b, R211, R216) from a sibling checkout / pinned tag tree to the in-repo portal/ working tree after the history-preserving import

events.summary: Only the portal seam checks (check-oidc-rbac-portal-contract.sh, check-kaniko-tag-portal-contract.sh, R55/R117/R117b/R211/R216 in regression-check-kakao.sh), the R210 pathspec, the .gitignore re-include for portal route dirs, a Vagrantfile/15-script path comment, docs and ADR-0001 change. Image pin ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.0.19, .github/**, portal/ source and live clusters are untouched.

At 498a3ae (post-import) the checks still looked for a sibling repo: running the old check-oidc-rbac-portal-contract.sh and check-kaniko-tag-portal-contract.sh from a tree without ../narwhal-portal printed 'SKIP: narwhal-portal sibling checkout not found at ../narwhal-portal -- nothing to compare' and exited 0 although portal/ sat in the same repo; R211 ran 'git -C <portal> ls-tree -r --name-only v<pin>' and printed 'SKIP R211 sibling ../narwhal-portal checkout absent'. The first --static run after the rewire also exposed two import side effects: R210 FAIL (portal/CHANGELOG*, portal/SECURITY.md mention older image tags) and R35 FAIL (root .gitignore patterns logs/, secrets/, kubeconfig match tracked portal route dirs).

Both contract scripts default PORTAL_DIR to portal/ and exit 1 (FAIL, not SKIP) when the file is missing; R55/R117/R117b/R216 lose their sibling/warn branches and always run against portal/; R211 asserts the probe routes in the portal/ working tree (no tag) and gets a negative test R211b on a mutated temp tree; R210 excludes portal/CHANGELOG* and portal/SECURITY.md; .gitignore re-includes /portal/src/**/{logs,secrets,kubeconfig}/. Existing mutation tests (removed 'viewer' group, mutated kaniko tag, removed GITEA_TOKEN) are kept and now mutate temp copies of in-repo files.
